name: Nichi Haruka
source: The engineer of the ship. Her family was poor and she has 7 brothers. She disliked all of them but her oldest brother Jin. She and Jin usually go to the library. It was there that Haruka became interested in engineering and other fields. She owes what she learned and made to her inspiration Professor Motokomi.
